items.title: Apple and Amazon face revived UK consumer lawsuit over product sales
items.summary: LONDON, Sept 28 () - Britain's Competition Appeal Tribunal on Monday allowed part of a consumer lawsuit against Apple and ‌Amazon to proceed over claims they restricted competition in the ‌sale of Apple products on Amazon's UK marketplace. The lawsuit alleges Apple and Amazon agreed ​in 2018 to limit which sellers could offer Apple and Beats-branded products on Amazon's UK website, reducing competition and inflating prices.
